title: Screen New Clients and Automate Responses | Make AI Agents

author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
AI Agents bring intelligent decision-making to your automations. Make can automate workflows across thousands of apps. But sometimes you need a step in the workflow that can make decisions about which information is relevant and how information should flow in your scenario.

This video shows how to set up a Make Scenario with Make AI Agents to screen emails and automatically load new client leads into a project board in Trello. Another scenario will activate when leads are moved to the contacts list, sending an email inviting the clients to a meeting. You will also see how to use the Make Grid to visualize data flow across multiple workflow scenarios and troubleshoot issues.

What you’ll learn:
• Creating a workflow scenario in Make
• Automate across multiple apps
• Add AI Agents to scenarios for real decision-making
• Use the Make Grid to visualize and troubleshoot multiple scenarios
